purpose: Restore twelve runnable short arms after launching the E4 dense control and E16 learned/frozen/dense triplet.
hypothesis: Matched frozen controls will distinguish the best initialization and image-routing screens from fixed partitions, while the E4 linear pair tests whether fewer experts plus magnitude-sensitive routing makes assignments learnable.
alternative_explanation: Any accuracy movement is fixed partitioning or ordinary optimization rather than adaptive routing.
falsifier: Frozen matches learned, route reliance stays below 0.01, or the pair is dominated on OOD validation and worst-environment accuracy.
